data.name: Gunslinger Initiative
data.description: At 3rd level, as long as the gunslinger has at least 1 grit point, she gains the following benefits. First, she gains a +%1 bonus on initiative checks. Furthermore, if she has the Quick Draw feat, her hands are free and unrestrained, and the firearm is not hidden, she can draw a single firearm as part of the initiative check.|GunslingerInitiative

raw_tokens.value: At 3rd level, as long as the gunslinger has at least 1 grit point, she gains the following benefits. First, she gains a +%1 bonus on initiative checks. Furthermore, if she has the Quick Draw feat, her hands are free and unrestrained, and the firearm is not hidden, she can draw a single firearm as part of the initiative check.|GunslingerInitiative
